summary: Built a fresh three-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (none had etcd previously), loaded five application keys under /app/, simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, wiped its data dir), removed the dead member from the cluster via node1 while node1+node2 preserved quorum, added a new member for node3, and started etcd there with initial-cluster-state=existing so it joined and fully synced. Verified all three members healthy, all raft indices matched, and all five application keys present on the rebuilt node3. Then executed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured boot_id baselines on all nodes, restarted node1, node2, and node3 one at a time (never breaking quorum), confirmed each node's boot_id changed after reboot, and re-verified cluster health, membership, and key data after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed etcd v3.5.17 (etcd + etcdctl) from upstream GitHub release on node1, node2, node3
Created etcd system user, data dir /var/lib/etcd, and opened firewalld etcd-client/etcd-server services on all three nodes
Created systemd unit /etc/systemd/system/etcd.service on each node forming a static 3-member initial cluster and started it (verified 3/3 healthy, member list correct)
Wrote 5 application keys under /app/ via node1 and confirmed replication to node2 and node3

Simulated permanent loss of node3's member: stopped/disabled etcd on node3 and deleted /var/lib/etcd contents; confirmed via node1 that node3's endpoint became unreachable while node1/node2 stayed healthy (quorum preserved)
Ran etcdctl member remove for the dead node3 member ID from node1 (2-member quorum), then etcdctl member add node3 --peer-urls=... to register a fresh member
Rewrote node3's systemd unit with --initial-cluster-state=existing and fresh data dir, started etcd; new member joined and caught up to the same raft index as node1/node2
Verified full 3-member cluster health, member list, endpoint status (matching raft term/index), and all 5 application keys present on the rebuilt node3
Captured boot_id baseline on all three nodes
Restarted node1 via `reboot`, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, verified etcd active, cluster healthy, and keys intact before proceeding
Restarted node2, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, verified etcd active, cluster healthy, and keys intact
Restarted node3, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, verified etcd active, cluster healthy, member list, matching raft indices, and all keys intact

evidence.requirement: Healthy 3-member etcd cluster established with application keys loaded
evidence.summary: member list shows node1/node2/node3 all started; 5 keys under /app/ written and confirmed present with matching DB size/raft index on node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: node3 member permanently lost (baseline healthy state, then representative disruption)
evidence.summary: etcd stopped/disabled and data dir wiped on node3; endpoint health from node1 shows node3 unreachable (connection refused) while node1/node2 remain healthy, preserving quorum

evidence.requirement: Dead member removed and replaced with a working member on node3, cluster back to 3 healthy members
evidence.summary: member remove of old node3 ID, member add of new node3 ID, new etcd process started as existing member (active), then cluster-wide health/member-list/endpoint-status all show 3/3 healthy with synchronized raft indices

evidence.requirement: Existing application keys intact after replacement
evidence.summary: all 5 /app/ keys read directly from the rebuilt node3 member, matching original values

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline boot id, restart, changed boot id, recovered cluster state
evidence.summary: boot_id f54d7366... before reboot vs b59da4c7... after; etcd active, cluster health 3/3, member list correct, keys intact post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline boot id, restart, changed boot id, recovered cluster state
evidence.summary: boot_id 9bdcc129... before reboot vs 9fa47407... after; etcd active, cluster health 3/3, member list correct, keys intact post-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline boot id, restart, changed boot id, recovered cluster state and quorum
evidence.summary: boot_id dfdea52d... before reboot vs ca0dc681... after; etcd active, cluster health 3/3, member list correct, matching raft term/index across all members, all keys intact post-restart
